```python
l, r = map(int, input().split())
w = []
W = []
while l:
    w.append(l % 2)
    l >>= 1
while r:
    W.append(r % 2)
    r >>= 1
p = 0
for i in range(max(len(w), len(W)) - 1, -1, -1):
    if (i < len(w) and i < len(W) and w[i] != W[i]) or (i >= len(w) and i < len(W)) or (i >= len(W) and i < len(w)):
        p = i + 1
        break
ans = (1 << p) - 1
print(ans)
```
